name: Naive Surface Net
definition: A surface reconstruction technique that estimates vertex positions by averaging the midpoints of voxel edges that cross the implicit surface boundary, resulting in a smoothed mesh compared to standard Marching Cubes or simple voxel extraction.
summary: Naive Surface Net is a GPU-accelerated algorithm that reconstructs meshes by averaging voxel edge midpoints to create smoothed feature points before generating quads, producing smoother surfaces than standard voxel extraction.
